parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing criminalisation, border check or facility ban is documented; regional-union documents are accepted and gender identity appears in anti-discrimination law. These positives prevent a severe rating. Risk arises from social/official hostility: failed anti-transition bills, a culture minister’s hostile statement, lethal shooting at an LGBT capital venue, Pride disruption, weak post-2022 care-standard implementation, and nonrecognition of same-sex partners for next-of-kin purposes. If outed, a visitor could face service or emergency-care denial, harassment and, though rare, severe violence; recourse exists on paper but effectiveness is undocumented. The absence of a universal visitor restriction keeps this above Elevated-Risk anchor cases with birth-sex searches or custody, while hostility and poor enforcement keep it below well-remediated Reduced-Risk profiles.
